main.description: Turn the caller's maintenance emails on or off, in their preferences space. Account email (links they ask for, a note when their contact email changes, changes to the terms) has no switch. Customers and staff; anyone else is refused.

idempotencyKey.description: A UUID the client generates once per action and resends on every retry of it.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: This endpoint requires an authenticated caller.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is neither a customer nor staff, or the provisioner refused them.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The input is malformed, or the provisioner refused it as malformed.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner. Not expected here; declared because every provisioner refusal is mapped the same way.
